sections.heading: Evidentiary Burdens under BSA 2023 (ss. 104–106 & s. 63)
sections.body: The asserting party ordinarily bears the initial burden on essential facts, subject to admissions and statutory presumptions. Electronic records should be authenticated under the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023.
